headline: ShelfMitra's funded Kolkata push is the biggest threat; StockSathi's ₹699 Pro cut follows [ShelfMitra-2-1][StockSathi-2-1]
tl_dr: ShelfMitra raised ₹200 crore to expand into eastern India and opened a new 12-opening Field Sales Executive role in Kolkata [ShelfMitra-2-1][ShelfMitra-2-3].
ShelfMitra also added a Bulk GST invoice export that downloads a month of invoices as one ZIP [ShelfMitra-2-2].
StockSathi cut Pro from ₹999 to ₹699 a month, adding UPI Udhaar and 2 devices, which undercuts KiranaCloud's ₹799 Dukaan plan by ₹100 [StockSathi-2-1].
StockSathi launched UPI Udhaar on 2026-10-13, letting shops give store credit and collect via UPI with automatic reminders [StockSathi-2-2].
BahiBook's Solo (₹399) and Plus (₹899) prices are unchanged, and its only changelog entry is an A5 invoice print fix [BahiBook-2-1][BahiBook-2-2].
since_last_week: Week 1 rated StockSathi's ₹499 Basic plan as the headline threat; this week StockSathi's Pro plan was cut to ₹699 with UPI Udhaar added [StockSathi-2-1].
StockSathi launched UPI Udhaar on 2026-10-13, a feature absent from the week 1 picture [StockSathi-2-2].
Week 1 rated ShelfMitra low; it is now rated high after the ₹200 crore Series B and the new Kolkata sales roles [ShelfMitra-2-1][ShelfMitra-2-3][ShelfMitra-2-4][ShelfMitra-2-5].
ShelfMitra added a Bulk GST invoice export on 2026-10-15 [ShelfMitra-2-2].
BahiBook's pricing is unchanged, and it added an A5 invoice print fix dated 2026-10-14 [BahiBook-2-1][BahiBook-2-2].
StockSathi's app-store rating fell from 4.4 to 4.3 across 18,469 reviews [StockSathi-2-3].

threats.rationale: A ₹200 crore Series B for eastern expansion and a new 12-opening Field Sales Executive role in Kolkata put funded sales pressure on home accounts [ShelfMitra-2-1][ShelfMitra-2-3]. The Bulk GST invoice export adds compliance appeal [ShelfMitra-2-2], and further Kolkata sales roles were also added [ShelfMitra-2-4][ShelfMitra-2-5].
The Pro cut to ₹699 sits ₹100 below Dukaan and adds UPI Udhaar and 2 devices [StockSathi-2-1]. UPI Udhaar competes directly on store credit collected via UPI [StockSathi-2-2].
The Solo ₹399 and Plus ₹899 prices are unchanged, and the only changelog entry is an A5 invoice print fix [BahiBook-2-1][BahiBook-2-2]. No new roles were added this week [BahiBook-2-3].

recommendations.action: Defend Kolkata accounts this week against ShelfMitra's field sales push: prioritise retention calls and renewal offers for high-value Kolkata stores before the new reps reach them.
Decide this week whether to respond to Dukaan's pricing: set a go/no-go on any Pro price move within the ₹649 to ₹699 band before the ₹100 gap is used against KiranaCloud.
Accelerate Khata on UPI scope this month so KiranaCloud's UPI-linked credit is ready before UPI Udhaar launches, about two quarters out, and overlaps Khata directly.

watchlist: StockSathi's rating dip from 4.4 to 4.3, with the top complaint still 'Occasional sync delays' [StockSathi-2-3].
The ₹100 Pro gap is 12.5% of Dukaan's ₹799, below the 20% escalation trigger in the battlecard [StockSathi-2-1].
BahiBook's free one-hour GSTR-1 webinar for first-time filers, a blog announcement with no impact rating [BahiBook-2-4].
discounted_claims: None: no signal in this week's set has credibility below 0.5, so no claim is discounted. BahiBook-2-4 (credibility 0.6) is reported as a blog announcement, not as fact.
